summary: E-commerce project with order management system. Building a checkout form (name, email, phone, delivery address, order notes) for all customers including guests, and an admin panel showing orders list with full customer details inline (order ID, date/time, customer info, items, total, status).
architectural_notes: All customer details (name, email, phone, delivery address) must be captured and stored at checkout for both guest and registered users
Admin panel displays all orders with customer details inline (no separate detail view needed)

existing_features.title: Update the Cart/Checkout page (frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx and/or frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx) to collect the following fields from all customers (including guests, with no login required): Full Name, Email Address, Phone Number, Delivery Street Address, City, Postal Code, and Order Notes (optional). Validate required fields before allowing order submission. Pass all collected fields to the order creation call.

Redesign the Admin Orders page (frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx) to display full customer details inline within each order row/card without requiring a modal click. Each order entry must show: Order ID, Date & Time, Customer Full Name, Email, Phone, Full Delivery Address (street, city, postal code), Ordered Items with quantities and unit prices, Order Total, and Order Status. Use an expandable row or an always-visible detail section beneath each row in the list.

Update the OrderDetailModal (frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetailModal.tsx) to display all new customer fields (fullName, email, phone, street, city, postalCode, orderNotes) when an admin opens an individual order, so the full delivery address and contact info are shown there as well.

new_feature_requests.summary: Checkout form collecting name, email, phone, delivery address, and order notes for all customers including guests
Admin panel orders list showing order ID, date/time, customer name, email, phone, delivery address, items with quantities/prices, order total, and order status inline

Extend the backend Order type to include guest customer details: fullName (Text), email (Text), phone (Text), street (Text), city (Text), postalCode (Text), and orderNotes (Text, optional). Update all order creation endpoints (createOrder, or equivalent) to accept and persist these fields. Ensure existing orders remain intact via migration.
